title: Reset Heartbeat Stats Data to Zero on the VISU_DATA Screen
summary: Use the Heartbeat section RESET button on the Operator Station HMI VISU_DATA screen to clear the heartbeat timing statistics (Last/Max/Min in milliseconds) back to zero.
when_to_use: When the Operator Station HMI VISU_DATA screen Heartbeat section shows Last/Max/Min heartbeat timing values that you need to reset to zero using the on-screen RESET button.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the VISU_DATA screen, press the Heartbeat RESET button, and verify the displayed Last/Max/Min values reset to zero.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper HMI / WebVisu / VISU (Operator Station HMI)

access_required: Access to the Operator Station HMI to view and press controls on the VISU_DATA screen
system_preconditions: The VISU_DATA screen is available on the Operator Station HMI and contains the Heartbeat section with a RESET button

visual_references.description: Operator Station HMI Data Screen—Heartbeat Stats (Figure 4-22) showing the Heartbeat section with Last/Max/Min (ms) and the RESET button.

steps.title: Open the Operator Station HMI and navigate to the VISU_DATA screen
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that contains the Heartbeat section and its RESET button.
steps.instruction: On the Operator Station HMI, navigate to the VISU_DATA screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).
steps.expected_result: The VISU_DATA screen is displayed and the Heartbeat section is accessible on the screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The VISU_DATA screen shows the Heartbeat section with Last/Max/Min heartbeat timing values (milliseconds) and a RESET button.
steps.failure_condition: The VISU_DATA screen is not displayed, or the Heartbeat section/RESET button is not visible.

actions.label: Navigate to VISU_DATA
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the "VISU_DATA" screen (Operator Station HMI Data Screen).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 4.1.2.2: VISU_DATA SCREEN describes the Operator Station HMI Data Screen.

steps.title: Locate the Heartbeat section and the RESET button
steps.purpose: Identify the correct control used to reset heartbeat timing statistics.
steps.instruction: On the VISU_DATA screen, locate the "Heartbeat" section and the "RESET" button within that section.
steps.expected_result: You can see the Heartbeat section fields: Last, Max, Min (milliseconds) and the RESET button.
steps.healthy_condition: Heartbeat section shows Last/Max/Min values in milliseconds and a RESET button labeled for resetting the data to zero.
steps.failure_condition: The Heartbeat section fields (Last/Max/Min) or the RESET button are missing or not readable.

actions.label: Find Heartbeat RESET
actions.exact_action: Locate the "Heartbeat" section and the "RESET" button.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Figure 4-22 Heartbeat Stats: Last/Max/Min in milliseconds and a RESET button to reset the data to zero.

steps.title: Press the Heartbeat RESET button to reset the data to zero
steps.purpose: Clear the displayed heartbeat timing statistics back to zero.
steps.instruction: Press the RESET button in the Heartbeat section on the VISU_DATA screen.
steps.expected_result: The Heartbeat Stats values displayed for Last, Max, and Min reset to zero.
steps.healthy_condition: Last, Max, and Min (milliseconds) show reset-to-zero values after pressing RESET.
steps.failure_condition: Last/Max/Min do not reset to zero after pressing RESET.

actions.label: Reset heartbeat stats
actions.exact_action: Press this button to reset the data to zero.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Heartbeat Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing RESET.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Heartbeat section includes a RESET button to reset the data to zero; Heartbeat provides Last/Max/Min in milliseconds.

steps.title: Verify Heartbeat Last/Max/Min values show reset-to-zero
steps.purpose: Confirm the reset action succeeded on the live HMI display.
steps.instruction: Verify that the Heartbeat fields (Last, Max, Min in milliseconds) now display zero values.
steps.expected_result: Last, Max, and Min show zero (reset-to-zero values) on the VISU_DATA screen.
steps.healthy_condition: All three displayed heartbeat timing metrics (Last, Max, Min) are at zero after the reset.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of Last/Max/Min remain non-zero after the reset.

actions.label: Check Last/Max/Min
actions.exact_action: Verify the Heartbeat fields (Last, Max, Min in milliseconds) show reset-to-zero values as displayed.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Heartbeat Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing RESET.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Heartbeat Stats: Last/Max/Min in milliseconds; RESET button resets the data to zero.

success_criteria: After pressing RESET, the VISU_DATA screen Heartbeat Stats fields Last, Max, and Min (milliseconds) display zero values.
healthy_conditions: Heartbeat section on VISU_DATA shows Last/Max/Min values in milliseconds and RESET button is present.
After reset, Last/Max/Min display reset-to-zero values.
failure_conditions: Heartbeat Stats Last/Max/Min do not reset to zero after pressing the Heartbeat RESET button.
escalation_guidance: If the Heartbeat Stats values do not reset to zero, stop and escalate for support rather than repeatedly pressing RESET.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Heartbeat section provides Last/Max/Min in milliseconds and includes a RESET button to reset the data to zero.
